svg.metadata: {"id": "s105", "name": "金秋消防站", "cat": "季节专题", "tags": ["安全", "消防", "119", "秋天"], "desc": "金秋的消防站：红色消防站、敞开的车库门里停着消防车、训练塔，门前两棵金黄大树和落叶，适合讲 119 报警与消防员叔叔。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [520, 1400]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": 0}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": 0.05}, {"name": "station", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": 0.3}, {"name": "truck", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": 0.45}, {"name": "siren", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": 0.45}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": 0.6}, {"name": "trees", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": 0.65}, {"name": "hose", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": 0.75}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "fall", "depth": 0.9}], "palette": {"sky1": "#86C6EE", "sky2": "#FFEFD4", "bld": "#E04A3B", "bld2": "#B9342A", "bld3": "#F5E6D4", "door": "#F2F2F2", "door2": "#C9CED6", "win": "#A9D6F0", "truck": "#E2382F", "truck2": "#B42820", "truck3": "#F2F2F2", "tire": "#2F3640", "ladder": "#C9CED6", "light": "#3FA1F2", "light2": "#FF4A3D", "ground": "#D9D2C6", "ground2": "#BDB4A6", "line": "#FFFFFF", "t1": "#F6B930", "t2": "#FFD95A", "t3": "#E07A22", "t4": "#D9542B", "trunk": "#7A4E33", "trunk2": "#5E3A26", "hose": "#F2C14A"}}
